blockers: G-01: user confirmed existing requirement scope in D-15 on 2026-10-22; provider agreement not independently reviewed; technical gates remain required

Additional post-Apply fields have observed labels but no verified execution mappings
Quantity bounds are observed UI constraints, not a successful quote for all quantities

empty_selection.meaning: For CNC/6061-T6, empty selection read back as Not required after Apply and A Save configuration (RD-LIVE-READBACK-20261021). This is unquoted configuration evidence; geometry and quote capability did not pass.

cosmetic_part.label: Cosmetic part
cosmetic_part.availability: Visible after Apply in current live UI; selected label No, Yes requires 2D drawings. Raw platform value and change/save behavior remain unverified; not a frozen request default. RD-LIVE-READBACK-20261021.

inserts.label: Inserts
inserts.availability: Visible after Apply in current live UI; selected label No, Yes requires 2D drawings. Raw platform value and change/save behavior remain unverified; not a frozen request default. RD-LIVE-READBACK-20261021.

part_marking.label: Part Marking
part_marking.availability: Visible after Apply with empty selection. Labels: Laser engraving, Screen printing, CNC carving, Pad printing (2D drawings required). Platform IDs/absence semantics unverified. RD-LIVE-READBACK-20261021.

inspection_report.label: Inspection Report
inspection_report.availability: Visible after Apply, empty. Labels include Routine, First Article, Formal, CMM, Third-Party RoHS, Hardness, Surface Treatment reports. Page states a report adds a fee and requires manual quotation. IDs unverified. RD-LIVE-READBACK-20261021.

tolerance.label: Tightest Tolerance
tolerance.availability: Selected label ISO2768M. Other observed labels ISO2768C, ISO2768F, Custom tolerancess (2D drawings required). No raw IDs or cross-provider equivalence verified. RD-LIVE-READBACK-20261021.

threads.label: Threads and Tapped holes
threads.availability: Selected label No threads; Standard threads and Custom threads require 2D drawings. This observed test setting is not proof of functional thread requirements in the source CAD. RD-LIVE-READBACK-20261021.
